## Model for summative question

### The model

We treat per-cent cover as a count on the log scale, add the distance and flow effects, and let each site have its own random intercept to absorb transect-to-transect clustering:

$$
\text{cover}_i \sim \text{Poisson}(\lambda_i), \qquad \log(\lambda_i) = \alpha + \beta\,\text{dist}_i + \beta_{\text{flow}}\,(\text{flow}_i - 1) + b_{\text{site}[i]}, \qquad b_j \sim \text{Normal}(0, \sigma_b)
$$

```
model {
  for (i in 1:N) {
    cover[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])
    log(lambda[i]) <- alpha + beta * dist_to_logging_km[i] + beta_flow * (flow[i] - 1) + b[site[i]]
  }
  for (j in 1:J) {
    b[j] ~ dnorm(0, sigma.b)
  }
  alpha     ~ dnorm(0, 10)
  beta      ~ dnorm(0, 5)
  beta_flow ~ dnorm(0, 5)
  sigma.b   ~ dunif(0, 10)
}
```

Set `N` and `J` (the number of sites, 20) in the constants.
